name: Past Efforts in Warsong Gulch
summary: In Warsong Gulch, soldiers fight for Ashenvale while commanders honor their sacrifices. Capital officers accept the Ribbon of Sacrifice as a sign of steadfast service, even when battles bring no clear victory.

sections.title: Honoring the Fallen and the Valiant
sections.body: The Silverwing Sentinels and Warsong Outriders fight brutal skirmishes along Ashenvale’s southern border. Many battles end without a clear victory. Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and other capitals honor those who hold their ground despite the odds. The Ribbon of Sacrifice marks fighters who gave themselves to the struggle.

sections.title: The War Effort at Home
sections.body: Far from the front, Alliance Brigadier Generals and Horde Warbringers oversee their forces. Recruiters send new fighters to Warsong Gulch, while quartermasters and tacticians account for veterans returning from hard campaigns. By honoring courage in stalemate or defeat, their leaders help keep soldiers committed to holding Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this commendation?
faq.answer: The commendation honors fighters who gave everything in Warsong Gulch. Capital commanders accept the Ribbon of Sacrifice to recognize their perseverance and sustain morale.

faq.q: Who accepts these tokens of sacrifice?
aliases: where to turn in past efforts
faq.answer: Alliance Brigadier Generals and Horde Warbringers accept the tokens in major cities, including Stormwind and Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does the military reward efforts that did not lead to victory?
faq.answer: Commanders know the fighting in Ashenvale’s forests takes a heavy toll. Honoring soldiers’ dedication shows that their sacrifice matters even when they do not win.

faq.q: Where does the conflict of Warsong Gulch take place?
faq.answer: Warsong Gulch lies along Ashenvale’s southern border. The Warsong Outriders gather lumber there while the Silverwing Sentinels resist them.

faq.q: Can members of both the Alliance and Horde undertake this?
faq.answer: Yes. Both factions honor returning soldiers through their military leaders in their respective capitals.

faq.q: What does the Ribbon of Sacrifice represent?
faq.answer: The Ribbon of Sacrifice honors fighters who endured fierce clashes in Warsong Gulch and remained willing to fight for their people.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, presenting a ribbon to a Brigadier General affirms your pledge to defend the ancient forests and support your night elven allies against Warsong aggression.
As a member of the Horde, presenting a token to a Warbringer affirms that the blood spent securing wood and survival in Ashenvale was not wasted.
As a warrior, you know the brutal melee in the gulch. Discipline means fighting fiercely even when victory hangs in the balance.
